outputs: image and buffer usage flag arrays
invariants: calculate clears reusable vectors and export set first
access previous points to prior access for same resource; next starts NO_ACCESS and is linked later
lifetime first/last access use NO_ACCESS sentinel
origin tag 0 starts without lifetime; tags 1/2 start at pass zero
only lifetime endpoints with tag exactly 1 emit events
end event sets bit 16, start event leaves bit 16 clear
exports require index < 65536 and insert index even for zero masks
dependency and public-library implementations remain outside candidate scope
panic_order: earlier access append/lifetime writes remain before access-mask conversion panic
export zero mask bypasses usage conversion and array bounds
unsupported descriptor/access mask and out-of-range resource/index are rejected
limitations: does not establish original Rust ABI, enum names, hashbrown layout or GPU ownership
uses canonical None payloads and zero padding
does not cover ResourcePool, ResourceRegistry physical allocation, barriers or executor
